scope: CA_1-CA_4 / TX_1-TX_3 / WI_1-WI_3, 30,490 SKU, 28-day cumulative, 4 evaluation windows

quantile_additivity.note: In the M3 bottom_up quantile panel, the relative difference between a top node's value and the sum of all leaf quantiles; high-level cumulative quantiles are outside this project's item-store analysis scope, this diagnostic is an extended record only, is not used for the report's headline results, and does not affect the leaf-level cost conclusion

store_level_quantile_calibration_tau0.95.note: Coverage of realised store demand by the store-level 28-day cumulative quantiles (10 stores × 4 windows); at τ=0.95 the stock is 1.45–1.50 times realised demand, and at τ=0.50 only 2 stores are covered; this item is an extended diagnostic, does not enter the headline results, and does not affect the leaf-level cost conclusion

limitations: Mode B (store-total ordering) allocates the total to SKUs by SKU point-forecast share and does not use a better within-store allocation rule

Only lightgbm has 28-day cumulative quantiles on both the M2 and the M3 side; the baselines' cumulative quantiles are built by M4 as "point forecast + empirical error quantile" and are not included in this comparison
Quantile coverage is counted node by node (10 stores × 4 windows); the sample is small, so tail τ values are indicative only

total_level_quantile_calibration_tau0.95.note: The single total node at τ=0.95 reaches only 0.96–0.99 of realised demand, the opposite direction from store level; this item is an extended diagnostic, does not enter the headline results, and does not affect the leaf-level cost conclusion
